BackNine Insurance | Remote (US) or Westlake Village, CA | Full-time | https://back9ins.com

BackNine is a B2B2C insurtech platform that automates the insurance sales process. Thousands of companies—from brick-and-mortar agencies to publicly traded banks—use BackNine to quote, apply, and manage insurance online.

We’re looking for an engineer to own and expand our API integrations with external systems, especially CRMs (e.g., Salesforce, Applied Epic).

https://back9ins.com/careers
